title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・足りない欠片

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio shows what she's made of and beats Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking this achievement into account, I decide the next race she should enter is the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days later, Tokai Teio spots Mejiro McQueen training ferociously. She admires her tenacity. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Teio is confident that no matter how many times they race, she'll always win. Symboli Rudolf, on the other hand, disagrees.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rudolf's statement throws Teio and her efforts to work toward the Japan Cup into a tailspin.
